pill.desc: white to off-white, round, flat, nonscored tablet

clues.kinetics: Food delays absorption without changing its extent. It is over 99% protein bound, mainly to serum albumin, and extensively metabolized, with 15% to 30% of the dose recovered in urine.
clues.substance: A hydrochloride salt whose active moiety has a molecular weight of 356.4, and it is practically insoluble in water.
clues.product: Approved under an NDA in 15, 30 and 45 mg tablets, dosed once daily.
clues.safety: Boxed warning: it can cause or worsen congestive heart failure. Contraindicated to start in NYHA class III or IV heart failure, and in hypersensitivity to any component.
clues.indication: Adjunct to diet and exercise to improve glycemic control in adults with type 2 diabetes, but not for type 1 diabetes or diabetic ketoacidosis.
clues.mechanism: It is a PPAR gamma agonist that reduces insulin resistance in peripheral tissues and the liver, and it is not an insulin secretagogue.

tell: A boxed warning for congestive heart failure and a mechanism that depends on endogenous insulin set this thiazolidinedione apart.

evidence.pk.tmaxH: T max of pioglitazone was within two hours
evidence.pk.halfLifeH: of pioglitazone and its metabolites (M-III and M-IV) range from three to seven hours
evidence.pill: White to off-white, round, flat, nonscored tablet
clues.kinetics: Food delays the T max to three to four hours but does not alter the extent of absorption (AUC)
Pioglitazone is extensively protein bound (>99%) in human serum, principally to serum albumin
extensively metabolized by hydroxylation and oxidation
approximately 15% to 30% of the pioglitazone dose is recovered in the urine
clues.safety: Thiazolidinediones, including ACTOS ®, cause or exacerbate congestive heart failure in some patients
Initiation in patients with established NYHA Class III or IV heart failure.
Use in patients with known hypersensitivity to pioglitazone or any other component of ACTOS.
clues.indication: an adjunct to diet and exercise to improve glycemic control in adults with type 2 diabetes mellitus
should not be used to treat type 1 diabetes or diabetic ketoacidosis
clues.mechanism: Pioglitazone is an agonist for peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor-gamma (PPARγ)
ACTOS decreases insulin resistance in the periphery and in the liver
Pioglitazone is not an insulin secretagogue
